datasets.name: Cost-as-a-proxy demo (synthetic)
datasets.source: Synthetic, scripts/make_demo_datasets.py, modelled on Obermeyer et al., Science 366(6464):447-453 (2019), https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aax2342
datasets.note: SYNTHETIC: 4,000 patients, seed 2019. Groups A and B have the same distribution of true need; at equal need group B's recorded cost is 30% lower (unequal access). predicted_cost comes from a linear regression on age, prior-year cost and insurance type; the top 20% by predicted cost are selected_by_cost, the top 20% by true need are high_need.
datasets.label: high_need

datasets.name: UCI Adult income (6,000-row sample)
datasets.source: Becker & Kohavi (1996), Adult, UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20
datasets.note: Random sample of 6,000 of the 32,561 rows of UCI Adult (adult.data), seed 42; '?' read as missing; fnlwgt dropped. predicted_income: out-of-fold (5-fold) logistic regression that does not see sex or race, seed 0.
datasets.label: income
